mode: Read-only source/policy audit; no build, test, model or HTTP execution
conclusions: Generator runs unbounded FFmpeg and independently duration-bounded FFmpeg; compares every bounded PCM byte against full output prefix before recording real counts/hashes. Qualifier requires positive bounded count, full>=bounded, consistent surplus and prefix evidence. No Python padding/resizing invents samples.

Clock exception is restricted to golos_09-aac/golos_10-aac with exact AAC/WAV hashes, source frame counts, movie/media/edit/STTS fields, 1024-sample priming and 12/13-sample movie-clock ceiling. Other cases and WAV controls retain one-sample tolerance.
Known golos_04 transcript correction is tied to exact candidate/human/WAV/FFmpeg text hashes; actual local fixture manifest contains the pinned human text. Other text differences fail.

Reference binding rehashes exact current canary/independent JSON, both binaries, all four model files and each input, then recomputes policy. Numeric, negative-input and health prerequisites remain enforced.

Negative offline policy/parser controls cover changed clocks/hashes/priming/STTS, missing full decode, shorter full output, stale canary, altered expectations/models/thresholds, unsupported duplicate/truncated box structures. This audit inspected those tests but did not execute them.

aac/input.rs.only_observed_change: cfg(test) ignored read amount changed to assert_eq!(read_bytes,prefix.len()); strengthens assertion, no runtime change

candidate5_invariants: Fully fed bytes before another Read; retained lookahead already fed and at most five unframed bytes.
Declared AU remainder forwards available prefix before another Read, preserving core header-before-IO error ordering; codec remains authority.
One ready block plus partial; one ADTS AU emits at most one native frame, <=8192 samples for four RDB/SBR.
Completed blocks precede deferred terminal errors; incomplete batch discarded; EOF invokes Decoder.finish; ISOBMFF classification priority preserved.
limitations: No claim here that final canary, independent FFmpeg runs, load/fault campaign or final decoder campaigns have passed; their fresh evidence is separate.
Native cheap guard/cold stack proof is not actual public consumer budget/cancel/model qualification.
MP4 parser is intentionally restricted to the two pinned version-0 single-track clock shapes, not a general MP4/conformance parser.
Policy validates recorded local evidence fields; actual full-prefix comparison occurs in presentation_evidence.py. Preserve generator commands/tool hashes with the resulting evidence.
Linux x86_64 measurements do not establish Windows/macOS/ARM parity.
